privacy.sent_web: Nothing. There are no analytics, trackers or ads. Error reports and game statistics stay in this browser.
privacy.sent_portal: The game itself sends nothing. The games site that hosts it shows the ads and keeps its own statistics, under its own privacy policy. Error reports stay in this browser.
privacy.personal: The game asks for no name, email or account and collects no personal data. A shared challenge link holds only the hunt's seed, mode, gun and score.
